nurbs.ui.title: Surfaces
The panel's heading (NURBS curves and surfaces).
Superficies
nurbs.ui.intro: NURBS curves and untrimmed surfaces with measured continuity (G0, G1, G2). Sizes are in millimeters.
Curvas NURBS y superficies sin recortar con continuidad medida (G0, G1, G2). Las medidas están en milímetros.
nurbs.ui.need.points: Type at least {n} points, one per line (x, y, z in mm), or pick them in the view.
Escriba al menos {n} puntos, uno por línea (x, y, z en mm), o selecciónelos en la vista.
nurbs.ui.need.edge: Pick a surface edge ({have} of {n}): click near the edge in the view, or an edge button in the list.
Seleccione un borde de superficie ({have} de {n}): haga clic cerca del borde en la vista o en un botón de borde de la lista.
nurbs.ui.need.end: Pick a curve end ({have} of {n}): click near the end in the view, or Start / End in the list.
Seleccione un extremo de curva ({have} de {n}): haga clic cerca del extremo en la vista o en Inicio / Fin de la lista.
nurbs.ui.ready: Ready: check the options and press Make.
Listo: revise las opciones y pulse Crear.
nurbs.ui.pick: Adds this item to the command.
nurbs.ui.points.label: Points (x, y, z in mm, one per line)
Field label.
Puntos (x, y, z en mm, uno por línea)
nurbs.ui.points.pick: Click points in 3D; Enter or a double click ends.
nurbs.ui.points.hint: Click points for the curve ({n} so far). Enter or a double click finishes, Esc cancels.
Haga clic en los puntos de la curva ({n} hasta ahora). Intro o un doble clic termina, Esc cancela.
nurbs.ui.pick.hint: Click a curve or surface in the view (near an edge or an end when the command asks for one). Esc stops.
Haga clic en una curva o superficie de la vista (cerca de un borde o extremo si el comando lo pide). Esc detiene.
nurbs.ui.pick.miss: That is not what the command needs next.
A pick that does not fit.
Eso no es lo que el comando necesita ahora.
nurbs.ui.empty: Nothing yet. Start with Curve through points under Curves.
Nada todavía. Empiece con Curva por puntos en Curvas.
nurbs.ui.krange: Gaussian curvature shown from {min} (blue, saddle) to {max} (red, dome) 1/mm²; white is flat.
Curvatura gaussiana de {min} (azul, silla) a {max} (rojo, cúpula) 1/mm²; el blanco es plano.
nurbs.ui.import: Import STEP, IGES or a patch set.
nurbs.ui.imported: Se agregaron {n} curvas y superficies de {file}.
nurbs.ui.opt.dir: Option (a vector in mm, or u / v).
nurbs.ui.opt.profiles: How many of the picked curves are profiles (the rest are guides)
Cuántas de las curvas seleccionadas son perfiles (el resto son guías)
nurbs.ui.err.option: Esa opción no se puede establecer.
nurbs.ui.err.zero: La distancia no puede ser cero.
nurbs.ui.err.vec3: Type three numbers: x, y, z.
Escriba tres números: x, y, z.
nurbs.ui.err.points: Each line needs two or three numbers (x, y, z).
Cada línea necesita dos o tres números (x, y, z).
nurbs.ui.err.import_empty: The file has no curves or surfaces this panel can read.
El archivo no tiene curvas ni superficies que este panel pueda leer.
nurbs.ui.err.export_empty: There is nothing to save yet.
Todavía no hay nada que guardar.
nurbs.ui.undo.label: Surfaces
Undo label prefix.
Superficies
nurbs.ui.g.trim: Command group: cut away part of a surface.
nurbs.ui.opt.u0: Option: where the trim starts across the surface, as a share.
nurbs.ui.opt.u1: Option: where the trim ends across the surface, as a share.
nurbs.ui.opt.v0: Option: where the trim starts along the surface, as a share.
nurbs.ui.opt.v1: Option: where the trim ends along the surface, as a share.
nurbs.ui.opt.u: Option: circle centre across the surface, as a share.
nurbs.ui.opt.v: Option: circle centre along the surface, as a share.
nurbs.ui.opt.r: Option: circle radius as a share of the surface.
nurbs.ui.opt.hole: Cut a hole (otherwise keep only this part)
Option: the loop removes its inside rather than keeping it.
Hacer un agujero (si no, se conserva solo esta parte)
nurbs.ui.trimmed: Item list: a surface with a trim.
nurbs.ui.solids: Heading of the list of solids.
nurbs.ui.need.solid: Pick a solid ({have} of {n}): click one of its faces in the view, or Pick in the Solids list.
Seleccione un sólido ({have} de {n}): haga clic en una de sus caras en la vista, o en Seleccionar en la lista Sólidos.
nurbs.ui.need.more_surface: Pick the surfaces that close the solid ({have} picked), or press Make to use every shown surface that is not in a solid yet.
Seleccione las superficies que cierran el sólido ({have} seleccionadas), o pulse Crear para usar todas las superficies visibles que aún no están en un sólido.
nurbs.ui.solid.none: No solids yet. Make a box, cylinder or sphere, or group surfaces that close a volume.
Aún no hay sólidos. Cree una caja, un cilindro o una esfera, o agrupe superficies que cierren un volumen.
nurbs.ui.solid.face_of: Item row: the surface is a face of a solid.
nurbs.ui.solid.delete: Delete the solid and its faces
Eliminar el sólido y sus caras
nurbs.ui.solid.made: {what}: done. Volume {volume} mm³, area {area} mm² (measured on triangles within {tol} mm of the surfaces).
{what}: hecho. Volumen {volume} mm³, área {area} mm² (medidos en triángulos a menos de {tol} mm de las superficies).
nurbs.ui.solid.bool_done: {what}: done, {faces} faces, volume {volume} mm³. The engine's points moved up to {dev} mm to sit on the exact surfaces (tolerance {tol} mm); intersection points lie within {res} mm of both surfaces.

{what}: hecho, {faces} caras, volumen {volume} mm³. Los puntos del motor se movieron hasta {dev} mm para quedar sobre las superficies exactas (tolerancia {tol} mm); los puntos de intersección están a menos de {res} mm de ambas superficies.
nurbs.ui.solid.closes: The new faces close again (volume {volume} mm³).
After a Boolean: the check passed.
Las caras nuevas vuelven a cerrar (volumen {volume} mm³).
nurbs.ui.solid.open_again: Check: sewn again from the exact faces, {n} edges stay open. Undo, or try a smaller tolerance.
After a Boolean: the check failed.
Comprobación: cosidas de nuevo a partir de las caras exactas, quedan {n} bordes abiertos. Deshaga, o pruebe una tolerancia menor.
nurbs.ui.opt.corner: Option: x, y, z of the box corner.
nurbs.ui.opt.base: Option: the middle of the cylinder base.
nurbs.ui.opt.center: Option: the middle of the sphere.
nurbs.ui.opt.keep: Option: leave the inputs in place.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_mc: Solids list button in ModelCraft: the solid becomes a closed group.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_name: Default name of a baked solid.
nurbs.ui.solid.baked_mc: {name} is in the model as a closed group: {n} triangles within 0.05 mm of its surfaces, volume {volume} mm³. The exact solid stays here.
{name} está en el modelo como un grupo cerrado: {n} triángulos a menos de 0,05 mm de sus superficies, volumen {volume} mm³. El sólido exacto sigue aquí.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_pc: Solids list button and dialog button in PartCraft.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_title: Bake a solid into the part
Integrar un sólido en la pieza
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_intro: The solid becomes a body of the part, as an opened STL does: its faces as triangles within the tolerance, added to the part, cut from it or intersected with it. It is one step in the part's undo; the exact solid stays in Surfaces.

El sólido se convierte en un cuerpo de la pieza, como un STL abierto: sus caras como triángulos dentro de la tolerancia, sumado a la pieza, restado de ella o intersecado con ella. Es un paso en el deshacer de la pieza; el sólido exacto sigue en Superficies.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_tol: Dialog field: how far the triangles may be from the surfaces.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_bad_tol: The tolerance must be from 0.001 to 10 mm.
La tolerancia debe estar entre 0,001 y 10 mm.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_big: That tolerance gives {n} triangles, too many for one body. Try a larger tolerance.
Esa tolerancia da {n} triángulos, demasiados para un cuerpo. Pruebe una tolerancia mayor.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_none: There is no solid to bake yet: make one in the Solids group of the panel.
Todavía no hay ningún sólido que integrar: cree uno en el grupo Sólidos del panel.
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_file: Where the baked body came from (shown like a file name).
nurbs.ui.solid.bake_failed: The part did not build with the baked solid: {why}. Undo takes it back.
La pieza no se construyó con el sólido integrado: {why}. Deshacer lo retira.
nurbs.ui.solid.baked_pc: {name} baked into the part ({op}): {n} triangles, volume {volume} mm³. The exact solid stays in Surfaces.
{name} integrado en la pieza ({op}): {n} triángulos, volumen {volume} mm³. El sólido exacto sigue en Superficies.
nurbs.ui.tb.bake.title: Bake a NURBS solid into the part (add, cut or intersect)
Toolbar tooltip.
Integrar un sólido NURBS en la pieza (sumar, restar o intersecar)
nurbs.ui.g.scan: Command group: surfaces from a scanned mesh.
nurbs.ui.scan.none: Select a mesh first: the scan to fit surfaces to.
Fit to scan with no mesh chosen.
Seleccione primero una malla: el escaneo al que ajustar superficies.
nurbs.ui.scan.done: Fitted {n} faces to {tris} triangles ({covered} % of the area). Measured from the scan to the faces: rms {rms} mm, largest {max} mm, {within} % of points within {tol} mm.
Result line of a scan fit.
Se ajustaron {n} caras a {tris} triángulos ({covered} % del área). Medido del escaneo a las caras: rms {rms} mm, máximo {max} mm, {within} % de los puntos a menos de {tol} mm.
nurbs.ui.scan.unfitted: {n} pieces could not be fitted (listed below).
Pieces left out of a scan fit.
nurbs.ui.scan.title: Scan fit
Heading of the fit table.
Ajuste al escaneo
nurbs.ui.scan.within: Column: share of points inside the tolerance.
nurbs.ui.scan.trimmed: A face cut to the scan piece outline.
nurbs.ui.scan.k.torus: Kind of face: a ring-shaped round face, here the rounded rim where a flat face meets a cylinder or cone.
nurbs.ui.scan.k.varfillet: Kind of face: a rounded edge whose radius changes along it.
nurbs.ui.scan.blendvar: A rounded edge whose radius changes along it: the radius at one end and at the other.
nurbs.ui.scan.ring: Torus face: the radius of the ring (axis to the middle of the round), in the kind column.
nurbs.ui.scan.radius: Radius of a cylinder or sphere face, in the kind column.
nurbs.ui.scan.halfangle: Half-angle of a cone face, in the kind column.
nurbs.ui.scan.blend: A round face that runs tangent into two or more other faces (a rounded edge or corner).
nurbs.ui.scan.fillets: {n} rounded edges or corners (fillets) were found, each with its radius.
Part of the scan result line.
Se encontraron {n} aristas o esquinas redondeadas (empalmes), cada una con su radio.
nurbs.ui.scan.devmap: Checkbox: colour the scan points by their distance to the fitted faces.
nurbs.ui.scan.devlegend: Colours show how far each scan point is from its face: blue on the face, green halfway, red at {tol} mm or more. Measured from the scan to the face only.
Los colores muestran qué tan lejos está cada punto del escaneo de su cara: azul sobre la cara, verde a la mitad, rojo a {tol} mm o más. Se mide solo del escaneo a la cara.
nurbs.ui.scan.u.folded: {tris} triangles fold back on themselves, so one surface cannot follow them
Why a piece was not fitted.
{tris} triángulos se pliegan sobre sí mismos, así que una sola superficie no los puede seguir
nurbs.ui.scan.u.small: {tris} triangles are too small a piece
Why a piece was not fitted.
{tris} triángulos son una pieza demasiado pequeña
nurbs.ui.scan.u.trim: Why a piece was not fitted.
nurbs.ui.scan.note: The error is measured from the scan points to the closest point of each face, not the other way round. {ign} % of the area was too small to fit and is not covered. Review the faces before relying on them.
Honest note under the fit table.

El error se mide desde los puntos del escaneo hasta el punto más cercano de cada cara, no al revés. El {ign} % del área era demasiado pequeña para ajustarse y no está cubierta. Revise las caras antes de confiar en ellas.
nurbs.ui.opt.gap: Option of Stitch to a solid: how far a loose edge may be from another face and still join.
nurbs.ui.opt.radius2: Radius at the end (mm, 0 = the same)
Fillet option: the radius at the far end of the edge; 0 keeps one radius.
nurbs.ui.opt.corners: Several-edge fillet option: round a corner where three flat, square faces meet with a sphere patch; off keeps the fillets creased.
nurbs.ui.opt.flip: Thicken option: thicken against the surface's normal.
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_done: Fillet radius {r} mm: {n} sections, the lofted surface within {dev} mm of the rolling ball, meeting both faces within {angle}°.
After a fillet: what was measured.
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_var: Fillet radius {r} to {r2} mm: {n} sections, the lofted surface within {dev} mm of the rolling ball, meeting both faces within {angle}°.
After a variable fillet: what was measured.
nurbs.ui.solid.thicken_done: {what}: {t} mm thick, volume {volume} mm³; the offset face is within {off} mm of the thickness everywhere it was measured (tolerance {tol} mm).
nurbs.ui.exported_shells: {n} solid(s) written as one closed shell each; {open} written as separate faces (their faces did not pair up edge for edge).
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_edges: After a several-edge fillet; {corners} is empty or the corner sentence below.
nurbs.ui.solid.fillet_corners: ; {sphere} corner(s) rounded as a sphere patch tangent to the three fillets, {mitre} corner(s) where two fillets run into each other along their intersection
Part of the several-edge fillet line.
nurbs.ui.g.cage: Command group: surfaces from a polygon mesh used as a cage.
nurbs.ui.cage.none: Select a mesh first: its quads are the cage.
SubD cage with no mesh chosen.
Seleccione primero una malla: sus cuadriláteros son la jaula.
nurbs.ui.cage.done: Made {n} exact surfaces from {quads} cage quads: bicubic B-spline patches, the Catmull–Clark limit, not an approximation.
Result line of a SubD cage command.
Se crearon {n} superficies exactas a partir de {quads} cuadriláteros de la jaula: parches B-spline bicúbicos, el límite de Catmull–Clark, no una aproximación.
nurbs.ui.cage.boundary: {n} quads on the cage's border were left out (the border has no exact patch here).
Se omitieron {n} cuadriláteros del borde de la jaula (aquí el borde no tiene un parche exacto).
nurbs.ui.cage.valence: {n} quads that touch a vertex with other than four edges were left out: the limit surface there is not a finite set of patches.
Se omitieron {n} cuadriláteros que tocan un vértice con un número de aristas distinto de cuatro: allí la superficie límite no es un conjunto finito de parches.
nurbs.ui.cage.open: {n} quads were left out because their neighbours do not close up (a hole or a flipped face next to them).
Se omitieron {n} cuadriláteros porque sus vecinos no se cierran (un agujero o una cara invertida a su lado).
